data.name: Eswara
data.gender_notes: Eswara is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Eswara is recorded with the meaning “Lord of the Universe”. Eswara is a Hindu name meaning “Lord of the Universe”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Eswara expresses “Lord of the Universe”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: ईश्वर
in_sanskrit.meaning: ईशान, ईश्वर और ईशानियाँ के प्रतिपादक, ज्योतिष्मा, पूजारा, धन्यवाद, स्वतंत्र और सहज शक्ति के साथ समुक्त हुए प्रभावशाली शक्ति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who embodies the absolute and pervasive power of the god Ishana, the god Ishvara and the goddesses Ishaniyas, the priest, the thankful one, the independent and the self-realized, and the inherent power

in_hindi.name: ईश्वरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईशान, ईश्वर और ईशानियाँ के प्रतिपादक

in_marathi.name: Eswara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eswara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The ruler of the universe, the supreme God, the embodiment of wisdom and power.

in_bengali.name: Eswara
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Eswara একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The ruler of the universe, the supreme God, the embodiment of wisdom and power.
